chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from Muhammad ibn 'Isa al-'Ubaydi, from 'Abd Allah ibn al-Mughirah, from Isma'il ibn Abi Ziyad, from Ja'far, from his father, from Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام:
“A man who had intercourse with his father’s wife was brought before him, so he ordered him to be stoned, though he was not muhsan.”

key_terms.أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amir al-Mu'minin, the title of Imam 'Ali عليه السلام
key_terms.رَجُلٌ: a man, the accused person in the case
key_terms.رُفِعَ: was brought or referred before the authority for judgment
key_terms.غَيْرَ مُحْصَنٍ: not muhsan; not in the legally protected marital state
key_terms.فَرَجَمَهُ: so he ordered him to be stoned

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Shia hadith on a man who has intercourse with his father’s wife?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal judgment from Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام regarding a man who committed intercourse with his father’s wife. It indicates the gravity of this prohibited act and presents a ruling connected to the penal law of zina in a case involving a father’s wife.
